finding_rule.G1-CONSISTENCY: Field {field} has {count} different values across the documents.
finding_rule.G1-SIGNATURE: Authorized signature data ({field}) is missing or inconsistent.
finding_rule.G1-VERSION-CURRENT: The package mixes order versions: {documents} is not the current version {version}.
finding_rule.WAV-DIVERSITY-REFERENCE: Route diversity is required but no reference circuit is given.
finding_rule.SEG-OTHER-CUSTOMER: The package names more than one customer.
finding_rule.DATE-CUSTOMER-CHANGE: A customer email asks for a requested date different from the signed order form.

finding_action.provide_missing_value: Ask the data owner for {field} and record its source document.
finding_action.confirm_correct_value: Ask the data owner to confirm which value of {field} is correct and have the other document corrected.
finding_action.reissue_stale_documents: Have {documents} reissued for the current order version {version}.
finding_action.obtain_authorized_signature: Obtain the authorized signature data ({field}) on the order form before intake continues.
finding_action.provide_diversity_reference: Ask the customer which circuit IDs this service must be diverse from.
finding_action.confirm_customer_and_remove_foreign_data: Confirm which customer the order belongs to and remove the other customer's document from the package. Do not share the package meanwhile.
finding_action.confirm_requested_date_change: Ask the customer whether the requested date has changed; a change needs a new order version. The signed order form date stays until then.

validation.reopened: Validation reopened by the new version

stage_assumption.order_signed: Assumed complete — order signed (no G0 record exists)

ui.orders_count: {count} orders from the local run files
ui.no_orders: No order files were found in {dir}.
ui.read_only: Read-only view. The agent recommends; a human decides.
ui.progress_method: Method: completed stages ÷ stages in the span; every stage has the same weight (rules/stages.json). Service delivery is Order received through Accepted (8 stages, the SDM scope, D68); end to end counts all {total}. A stage is completed only by a human decision at its gate. Parallel work inside the current stage does not change the percentage.
ui.workstreams_title: Parallel workstreams in the current stage
ui.workstreams_note: One row per open finding or open plan action (D60). These rows do not change the percentage.
ui.workstreams_none: Nothing open in this stage: no open finding or plan action.
ui.gate_human_decision: Human decision: override to pass, by {approver}. Reason: {reason}
ui.requirement_scoping_ok: No other customer of the tenant is named in the package
ui.no_value_found: No value is printed in any source document.
ui.changes_summary: {reopened} of {total} validations reopened; the rest are unchanged.
ui.changes_plan_impact: May affect the plan (the plan is built in Phase 4).
ui.changes_no_plan_impact: No plan impact expected from the changed fields.
ui.not_found: This order is not in the local run files.
ui.bucket_pending: Pending confirmation by the data owner
ui.bucket_needs_action_note: Contradictory, missing or stale fields, and every other finding that blocks G1. Each one has a finding.
ui.bucket_pending_note: Extracted and consistent across the documents. The data owner has not verified them yet; this does not block G1.
ui.bucket_not_set_note: No value is expected or none has been given yet.
ui.explain_missing: Not printed in any source document.
ui.explain_stale: Superseded by a newer order version.
ui.reason_condition_not_met: Conditional field: its condition does not hold for this order.
ui.reason_awaited: No value yet: printed as "{text}" in {document} ({page}).
ui.reason_not_set: No value has been given yet.
ui.follow_up_anchor_last_supplier_email: Counted from last supplier email ({date}) — no request record
ui.follow_up_history_not_answered: First follow-up was due {date} and not answered
ui.gate_human_approved: Human decision: pass, approved by {approver}. Reason: {reason}
ui.g2_records_note: Requirements are checked against gate records (approvals, assignments, confirmations, evidence). Records are seeded synthetic data; the agent never creates one.
ui.g2_not_evaluated: G2 has not been evaluated for this order version.
ui.plan_not_built: No plan for this order version yet.
ui.supplier_inputs_missing: Supplier inputs: missing ({items}). Delay: unknown, not a delay.
ui.dependencies_none: No supplier dependency in the package.
ui.bucket_pending_collapsed: Collapsed by default: these fields are consistent and need no action. Open to review by field group.

plan_action.follow_up_supplier: Follow up with the supplier for a firm date (FOC)
plan_action.escalate_supplier_follow_up: Escalate: the supplier has not given a firm date after the follow-up
plan_action.resolve_shared_resource: Resolve the shared resource once for all linked orders

g2_requirement.g1_passed: G1 passed by a human, no open critical finding
g2_requirement.ports_assigned: Ports assigned at A and Z
g2_requirement.optical_path_assigned: Optical path and A/Z ports or transponders assigned
g2_requirement.third_party_segments: Third-party segments with a firm FOC; access type known
g2_requirement.site_access: Site access and access contacts confirmed at each end
g2_requirement.route_diversity: Route diversity evidenced against the reference circuits

g2_missing.cross_connect_required_not_stated: Not stated whether a cross-connect is needed ({detail})
g2_missing.access_type_unknown: On-net or off-net access not confirmed
g2_missing.supplier_firm_foc: No firm FOC from the supplier ({detail})
g2_missing.route_diversity_required_not_stated: Not stated whether route diversity is required
